records.text: ahuan aidi binayu a mikiliw, "pang, pang" ka yaku

senses.zh: 晚上在山上叫“pang, pang”的就是我
senses.en: At night time (when a bird) cries 'pang, pang' in the mountain, that is me.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.62，ahu- 條下派生詞

senses.en: mud pool (with muddy water, where carabaos wallow)
a pole placed on one's shoulder to carry things on both ends
This pole can carry things on both ends.

records.text: mataru lia ka ini aisiiyay lia ki ina

senses.en: As they grew up, the mother behaved differently.
